messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

You can now enter a game name under “Reproduce a game” before exporting progress. The name returns when you load that snapshot. Existing unnamed snapshots remain supported.

Snapshot loading also accepts valid JSON properties in any order.

Validation passed: 141 unit and static tests, plus all 78 browser tests on the project’s named runtime combination. The repository-wide formatting check still reports three untouched files: `scripts/replay.test.ts`, `tests/accessibility.e2e.test.ts`, and `tests/layout.e2e.test.ts`.
